about: The invocation that closes the prayers of Leo XIII, added to them in 1904 under Pius X. It is said three times. This edition prints it once.

w001.function: A neuter noun has one form for nominative and vocative. This edition tags the address as nominative, as it does in Agnus Dei.

w002.function: Genitive dependent on “Cor”: the Heart of Jesus.

w003.function: The superlative of “sacrátus”. It agrees with “Cor” (w001).

w004.function: The imperative of a deponent verb: passive in form, active in meaning.

w005.function: Dative dependent on “miserére”. In Classical Latin this verb usually takes the genitive.
